name: searchCompany
description: Search DART company information. Use first when the user mentions a Korean company name, DART company, listed company, non-listed disclosure company, or Korean stock code.

query.description: Korean company name or stock code, e.g. 삼성전자 or 005930.

name: getDisclosures
description: Get DART disclosure filings. Use for DART filings, recent disclosures, annual reports, quarterly reports, audit reports, major reports, capital increases, CB/BW, major contracts, litigation, contingent liabilities, related parties, subsidiaries, audit opinion, or key audit matters.

company_name.description: Korean company name or stock code.

name: getFinancials
description: Get DART financial statement data. Use for DART financial statements, revenue, operating profit, net income, assets, liabilities, equity, cash flows, and financial ratios. Prefer DART for listed companies and disclosure companies.

company_name.description: Korean company name or stock code.

name: searchKrxStock
description: Search KRX stock information. Use when the user asks about Korean stock code, market segment, KOSPI, KOSDAQ, KONEX, ETF, or when company analysis requires KRX market data.

query.description: Korean company name or stock code.

name: getKrxDailyPrice
description: Get KRX daily price and trading data. Use for Korean stock or ETF share price, close/open/high/low, volume, trading value, market cap, recent stock performance, impairment indicator, fair value, listed peer data, or ETF daily trading data.

stock_code.description: Korean stock or ETF code, e.g. 005930.

market.description: Market segment. AUTO tries available markets and returns the first market with matched data.

name: getFscCompanyOverview
description: Get FSC company overview. Use for FSC company basic information such as representative, establishment date, industry, main business, corporate registration number, business registration number, auditor, audit opinion, and employee count.

base_date.description: Base date in YYYYMMDD format if needed.

name: getFscFinancialSummary
description: Get FSC company financial summary. Use for FSC company financial summary. Use business_year for year-specific lookup or latest_only=true for the latest available matched year. Cross-check important figures with DART.

base_date.description: Base date in YYYYMMDD format if needed.

business_year.description: Business year in YYYY format, e.g. 2025. Use when the user asks for a specific fiscal year.

latest_only.description: If true and business_year is omitted, return only rows for the latest business year available in matched FSC financial data.

name: getFscFinancialBalanceSheet
description: Get FSC company balance sheet data. Use for FSC balance sheet data such as assets, liabilities, and equity. Use business_year for year-specific lookup or latest_only=true for the latest available matched year. Cross-check key amounts with DART financial statements.

base_date.description: Base date in YYYYMMDD format if needed.

business_year.description: Business year in YYYY format, e.g. 2025. Use when the user asks for a specific fiscal year.

latest_only.description: If true and business_year is omitted, return only rows for the latest business year available in matched FSC financial data.

name: getFscFinancialIncomeStatement
description: Get FSC company income statement data. Use for FSC income statement data such as revenue, operating profit, and net income. Use business_year for year-specific lookup or latest_only=true for the latest available matched year. Cross-check key amounts with DART financial statements.

base_date.description: Base date in YYYYMMDD format if needed.

business_year.description: Business year in YYYY format, e.g. 2025. Use when the user asks for a specific fiscal year.

latest_only.description: If true and business_year is omitted, return only rows for the latest business year available in matched FSC financial data.

name: searchLaw
description: Search Korean laws Use to search Korean laws by law name or full text before retrieving an article/detail.

query.description: Korean law name or keyword, e.g. 상법, 외부감사법, 자본시장법.

sort.description: Sort option such as lasc, ldes, dasc, ddes.

name: getLawDetail
description: Get Korean law detail Use when law_id or mst is known and full law/detail or a specific article is needed.

name: getLawArticle
description: Get a specific Korean law article Use for non-tax Korean law articles. For tax laws, prefer getTaxLawArticle.

law_name.description: Korean law name, e.g. 상법, 외부감사법, 자본시장법.

name: searchTreaties
description: Search treaties including tax treaties Use for tax treaties, double tax treaties, withholding treaty rates, dividends, interest, royalties, PE, beneficial owner, LOB, and residence certificate issues.

query.description: Treaty keyword, country name, or topic. Example: 미국, 일본, 배당, 이중과세.

natCd.description: Country code used by Korea Law API.

name: getTreatyDetail
description: Get treaty detail text Use to retrieve treaty text by treaty_id/id, or search by query if ID is unknown.

query.description: Treaty keyword if treaty_id is unknown.

chrClsCd.description: Optional Korea Law API treaty language code. Overrides language.

name: searchLegalInterpretations
description: Search legal interpretations Use for non-tax legal interpretations or 법제처/정부 법령해석례 searches.

query.description: Search keyword.

name: getLegalInterpretationDetail
description: Get legal interpretation detail Use to retrieve a legal interpretation by ID or by searching query first.

query.description: Search query if ID is unknown.

name: searchConstitutionalCases
description: Search constitutional court cases Use for constitutional court cases involving tax, property rights, equality, retroactivity, or other legal issues.

query.description: Search keyword.

name: getConstitutionalCaseDetail
description: Get constitutional case detail Use to retrieve a constitutional case by ID or by searching query first.

query.description: Search query if ID is unknown.

name: searchLawTerms
description: Search legal terms Use for legal term definitions such as 특수관계인, 거주자, 실질귀속.

query.description: Legal term keyword.

name: getLawTermDetail
description: Get legal term detail Use to retrieve legal term detail by ID or by searching query first.

query.description: Term keyword if ID is unknown.

name: searchRelatedLaws
description: Search related laws Use to search related laws for a law name, law ID, or MST.

query.description: Search query if law_name is not used.

name: getTaxLawCatalog
description: Get tax law alias catalog Use to get server-side Korean tax law alias/canonical-name catalog. No parameters.

name: searchTaxLaws
description: Search Korean tax laws Use to search Korean tax laws by formal name, alias, or full-text keyword.

query.description: Tax law name, alias, or keyword, e.g. 법인세법, 조특법, 배당.

name: getTaxLawArticle
description: Get a specific Korean tax law article Use before answering Korean tax-law article questions, including 법인세법, 소득세법, 부가가치세법, 상증세법, 조특법, 국세기본법, 국제조세조정법, 지방세법, 관세법.

law_name.description: Tax law name or alias, e.g. 법인세법, 조특법, 상증세법.

name: getTaxLawPackage
description: Get tax law/decree/rule package Use when the user asks to check a tax law together with its enforcement decree and enforcement rule.

name: getTaxLawEffectiveArticle
description: Get tax law article by effective date Use for historical/effective-date tax law article lookup.

name: searchTaxLawHistory
description: Search tax law history Use for tax law amendment/history lookup.

name: searchTaxLawArticleHistory
description: Search tax law article history Use for amendment history of a specific tax law article.

name: compareTaxLawOldAndNew
description: Get old/new comparison for tax law Use for tax law old-and-new comparison after amendment.

name: compareTaxLawThreeWay
description: Get three-way comparison for tax law Use for tax law three-way comparison.

name: searchTaxCases
description: Search tax-related court cases Use for tax court cases, Supreme Court cases, precedents, and case law on tax issues.

query.description: Case search keyword.

org.description: Court type. Supreme Court=400201, lower courts=400202.

name: getTaxCaseDetail
description: Get tax case detail Use to retrieve tax case detail by ID or by searching query first.

query.description: Search query if ID is unknown.

response_type.description: Response format. HTML may be required for some NTS case texts.

name: searchTaxAppeals
description: Search tax tribunal decisions Use for 조세심판례, 조세심판원 결정례, 심판청구, 인용/기각 사례, or tax tribunal decisions.

query.description: Search keyword.

name: getTaxAppealDetail
description: Get tax tribunal decision detail Use to retrieve tax appeal detail by ID or by searching query first.

query.description: Search query if ID is unknown.

name: searchNtsInterpretations
description: Search NTS interpretations Use for 국세청 예규, 서면질의, 사전답변, 유권해석, 질의회신, or NTS interpretation on a tax issue.

query.description: Search keyword.

name: searchTaxAdminRules
description: Search tax administrative rules Use for tax-related administrative rules, notices, directives, rulings, and internal rules.

query.description: Search keyword.

name: getTaxAdminRuleDetail
description: Get tax administrative rule detail Use to retrieve tax administrative rule detail by ID/LID/name or by searching query first.

query.description: Search query if ID is unknown.

name: searchTaxAttachments
description: Search tax law attachments/forms Use for tax law schedules, forms, 별표, 별지, 서식, and attachments.

query.description: Search keyword.

name: searchTaxTerms
description: Search tax legal terms Use for tax-related legal term definitions such as 특수관계인, 거주자, 실질귀속.

query.description: Tax/legal term keyword.

name: getTaxTermDetail
description: Get tax legal term detail Use to retrieve tax legal term detail by ID or by searching query first.

query.description: Term keyword if ID is unknown.

name: searchTaxRelatedLaws
description: Search related laws for a tax law Use to search related laws for a tax law name, law ID, or MST.

name: getBusinessRegistrationStatus
description: Check Korean business registration status. Use for Korean business registration number active/suspended/closed status, tax type, closure date, invoice risk, and counterparty review.

business_numbers.description: Korean business registration numbers. Hyphens are allowed.

name: validateBusinessRegistration
description: Validate Korean business registration information. Use to validate whether business registration number, opening date, representative name, and optional business information match NTS records.

name: getNtsAssetValueEndpoints
description: List available NTS asset value years and endpoints. Use first when the user asks what years are available for NTS commercial building/officetel standard value data.

name: getNtsAssetStandardValue
description: Get NTS commercial building/officetel standard value. Use for NTS commercial building or officetel standard value lookup by year and optional building/address-related filters. Results are page-based and may require enough per_page/page coverage.

endpoint_index.description: Endpoint index for years with multiple endpoints.

building_number.description: Commercial building number exact-match server-side filter.

legal_dong_code.description: Legal dong code exact-match server-side filter.

keyword.description: Keyword filter within returned page data.

name: getRebStatisticTables
description: List Korea Real Estate Board R-ONE statistic tables. Use first for R-ONE real estate statistics to find STATBL_ID before item/data lookup.

name: getRebStatisticItems
description: List items for a Korea Real Estate Board R-ONE statistic table. Use after getRebStatisticTables to find DTACYCLE_CD, GRP_ID, CLS_ID, ITM_ID and other item identifiers.

name: getRebStatisticData
description: Get Korea Real Estate Board R-ONE statistic data. Use after table/item lookup to retrieve R-ONE real estate statistics such as housing price index or transaction statistics.

name: getBokStatisticTables
description: Search Bank of Korea ECOS statistic tables. Use first for BOK ECOS statistics to find statistic table codes by keyword such as 금리, 환율, 물가.

query.description: Search keyword, e.g. 금리, 환율, 물가.

name: getBokStatisticItems
description: List items for a Bank of Korea ECOS statistic table. Use after getBokStatisticTables to find item codes needed for statistic search.

name: searchBokStatistics
description: Get Bank of Korea ECOS statistic data. Use for BOK ECOS statistics data after identifying stat_code and item codes.

period.description: Period: A yearly, Q quarterly, M monthly, D daily, etc.

name: getBokKeyStatistics
description: Get Bank of Korea ECOS top 100 key statistics. Use for quick lookup of BOK 100 key economic indicators.
